## Authentication First

Before making any API calls, obtain a JWT access token using the Client Credentials grant flow (suitable for scripts/automation):

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://[tenant].api.identitynow.com/oauth/token' \
  --form 'grant_type="client_credentials"' \
  --form 'client_id="{clientId}"' \
  --form 'client_secret="{clientSecret}"'
```

Save the `access_token` from the response for use in subsequent calls.

---

## Grant a Role to a User

Use the **Submit Access Request** endpoint with `requestType: GRANT_ACCESS`:

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://[tenant].api.identitynow.com/v3/access-requests' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer {access_token}' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "requestedFor": ["identity-id-of-target-user"],
    "requestType": "GRANT_ACCESS",
    "requestedItems": [
      {
        "type": "ROLE",
        "id": "role-id-to-grant",
        "comment": "Granting role via API"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

---

## Revoke a Role from a User

Use the same endpoint with `requestType: REVOKE_ACCESS`:

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://[tenant].api.identitynow.com/v3/access-requests' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer {access_token}' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "requestedFor": ["identity-id-of-target-user"],
    "requestType": "REVOKE_ACCESS",
    "requestedItems": [
      {
        "type": "ROLE",
        "id": "role-id-to-revoke",
        "comment": "Revoking role via API"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

---

## Notes

- `requestedFor` takes an array of **identity IDs** (not usernames). You can look up an identity's ID via `GET /v3/identities?filters=name eq "username"`.
- `requestedItems[].id` is the **role ID**, found via `GET /v3/roles`.
- These requests may trigger approval workflows depending on your ISC configuration. Check the request status via `GET /v3/access-request-status`.
- The PAT must belong to a user with sufficient privileges to submit access requests on behalf of others (typically an admin or governance role).

```answer-summary
endpoints:
  - method: POST
    path: /oauth/token
    api_version: oauth
  - method: POST
    path: /v3/access-requests
    api_version: v3
auth_flow: OAuth2 bearer token (client credentials grant)
required_scopes: []
key_parameters: [requestedFor, requestType, requestedItems, type, id, comment]
```
